How GreenCycle works

Three steps. Real intention.

A simple idea for making positive environmental action easier to understand and take part in.

01

Collect & clean

Bring people together to help remove litter and waste from outdoor spaces.

02

Plant & protect

Support planting activities and look after the green spaces that already exist.

03

Track & inspire

Share progress, celebrate small wins and inspire more people to join in.
